Font Awesome Free 6.7.2
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/-/fontawesome-free-6.7.2.tgz

Unmodified css/all.min.css, webfonts/* and LICENSE.txt from the upstream package.

Includes solid, regular, brands and legacy compatibility fonts.
